report:
Reviewed the complete claim: recovery must represent failed checking explicitly; every error node must be backed by a diagnostic; unresolved alternatives must not be published as successful expressions. The ordinary InferCtx association implements the direct path: error_expr catches a CheckError, obtains the ErrorReported witness, and allocates both Ty::Error and TyExprData::Error with that witness. catch records fresh errors and reuses already-reported errors. The same file implements deferred-proof recovery: fail_obligation records the provenance diagnostic before recover_expr_slots replaces each affected expression slot with an explicit Error expression; terminalize_obligation_with_error reuses the originating witness instead of manufacturing success or duplicate diagnostics. finalize diagnoses unresolved inference classes, installs error recovery, and terminally discharges pending obligations; finish requires every expression slot to be filled and passes the diagnostic collection into CheckedBody.

Added and reviewed essential ordinary associations in diagnostic.rs and check/finalize.rs. Diagnostic::report appends the diagnostic before creating the privately constructible ErrorReported token. BodyFinalizer::copy_expr follows Unresolved slots recursively, detects cycles, and copies the actual resolved expression instead of emitting an unresolved successful-looking node. copy_expr_data preserves Error witnesses; copy_ty preserves Ty::Error and rejects escaped InferVar values. Recursive children are rebuilt through the same copy path. These associations ensure the diagnostic witness and final published representation remain part of future review inputs.

The complete test set contains one substantive test and one explicit TODO. failed_operator_proof_becomes_one_diagnostic_and_an_error_node checks an unsupported boolean addition using real external trait metadata. Its visible assertions require exactly one diagnostic containing the failed associated-type relation message and require the let initializer in the completed body to be TyExprData::Error. It would catch a retained successful-looking call or missing diagnostic. Captured helpers establish that this checks the named local function body in the supplied source, with the first evaluation returned after a second warm evaluation; warm-result assertions are not claimed. types_body_diagnosed_recovery is a TODO placeholder, not behavioral verification: exhaustive pairing of diagnostics/error nodes across unsupported constructs and recovery/completion scenarios remains deferred. Its stated prerequisite is adding that complete recovery scenario suite; the one operator case does not discharge it. This explicit breadth limitation is accepted as test TODO, not claimed implemented coverage or a new production deferral.

Validation executed: cargo fmt; cargo test -p sage-oracle-harness --test binary_operators failed_operator_proof_becomes_one_diagnostic_and_an_error_node (1 passed, 0 failed). No production behavior changed; only essential associations were added. The coordinator owns the centralized build, post-codegen review, and Sage sanity review. Source inspection and this focused executed test support the reviewed invariant with the existing wider-test TODO remaining visible.
